page.title: Webhooks
page.description: Send a message to another system (n8n, Zapier, your own program) when something happens here.
page.note: Each message is signed with a secret that only this webhook and the receiver know, so the receiver can check it came from FixFlow. The documentation page for the public API explains how to check the signature.

page.empty_text: Add one to be told when a work order is completed, an asset goes down, or a sensor alert is raised.

example.title: What a message looks like
example.intro: Each message is a POST with a JSON body, and these headers: X-FixFlow-Event (what happened), X-FixFlow-Delivery (an id that is the same if the message is sent again, so you can ignore repeats) and X-FixFlow-Signature (t=time,v1=signature: the HMAC-SHA256 of the time, a full stop and the body, made with the secret). Any answer from 200 to 299 counts as received; anything else is tried again later.
